cast.characterName: ジャック・ハミルトン
cast.originalCharacterName: ジャック・ハミルトン

segments.text: A wandering gunman. No one knows where he came from or what he's up to.
He travels the world, working for anyone who will hire him. That's probably why he knows so much about different places and events.
Jack seems to have his own goal for his journey, but he hasn't told anyone about it. For some reason, he actually tries to hang around Lyner during his travels.
He loves women, and even Lyner is amazed at how straightforward he is about it. He is a dependable, big brother type, to the point where he will do whatever it takes to protect his friends.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site
His real name is Harmonica De Pameli, and he is originally from the Teru Tribe.

cast.characterName: クルシェ・エレンディア
cast.originalCharacterName: クルシェ・エレンディア

segments.text: A Grathmeld engineer who lives in Firefly Alley. She knows a lot about airships and Grathnode items. Her dream is to cross the Blastline and go to the top of the tower.
She was born into a large family, and grew up unsupervised. Although she doesn't like dressing up too girly, she secretly admires it. She is kind of selfish and no-nonsense when it comes to money.
She occasionally blurts out mean jokes, but it's always in good fun.
She is only interested in airships and she'll keep researching until she makes her dreams come true.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site

cast.characterName: フィンネル_ax.鋳種クラスタニア
cast.originalCharacterName: フィンネル_ax.鋳種クラスタニア

segments.text: Singer: Haruka Shimotsuki
A rare Pureblooded β-type Reyvateil that was created by the Clustanians.
She's a little clumsy, and her clumsiness often makes people around her nervous.
She works and lives at Yokkora Bistro in Eternus Shaft as a waitress, but in fact, sheäs been burdened with the dark duty of helping Clustania achieve their secret plans.
Her secret will bring a big chance to Aoto's fate.
She loves cold treats like ice cream and snow cones, but because she's always so careless, she always gets brain freeze.
Edited from official site
A young steeplejack apprentice from Blue Canyon Hamlet.
He's sort of reckless and has a strong sense of responsibility. He always tries hard whenever he does something.
He always had hostile feelings towards Clustania because they destroy human communities in the name of "Cleansing", but ever since he met Saki, they've become a clear enemy.
From official site

cast.characterName: 咲_zx.零種フレードジャンクション
cast.originalCharacterName: 咲_zx.零種フレードジャンクション

segments.text: Singer: Akiko Shikata
A mysterious Reyvateil from the Archia Think Tank.
She was created to fulfill a grand purpose that will have a major impact on the world itself.
But before she could fulfill that purpose, she and Kiraha, an Archian agent who opposed the plan, fled from the Think Tank together.
After a few years, she meets Aoto in Blue Canyon Hamlet.
Under extreme pressure, she resorts to a special power called "Miracle".
From official site
One of Saki's personas, she fills the role of her older sister.
She speaks up about Saki's feelings on her behalf.
Because Saki values others more than her own feelings, she gets frustrated with Saki's altruistic decisions.
She often makes moves on the guy Saki likes.
From official site
One of Saki's personas. This persona undertakes all of the pain Saki can't withstand.
These multiple personae come into existence when someone forcefully segregates her traumatic feelings in order to defend her psyche. Filament is a paragon of such a persona.
Because of her background, she knows things about Saki that Saki herself doesn't even know.
Her knowledge often helps the party.
From official site
Saki's guardian, who shows up to defend her whenever she's in a crisis.
Her looks and personality are the total opposite of Saki's. She is very solemn and adamant.
Because of her conservative personality, if someone does something to put Saki at risk, even if that person is close to Saki, she comes forward to eliminate them.
From official site
Age: 13 (16 in English version; used to avoid legal reasons)
Singer: Rekka Katakiri
A girl who came from a faraway world of Metafalss to deliver a crystal known as the Heart of Gaea to Harvestasha.
She loves a character named Gergo, and she often says, "You're so boo!" when she's frustrated.
She's normally calm and meticulous, but because of her innate kindness, she always end up getting involved with other people's troubles.
From official site
Singer: Haruka Togawa
The second-in-command of the Archia Think Tank.
She fantasizes about a dramatic romance that is full of obstacles. She also encourages others to chase that kind of love.
From official site
Singer: Kokia

Tyria is the third Origin Reyvateil, and Administrator of the Third Tower in Sol Cluster and the Tower itself. She's the master of of the race that can convert Songs into various forms of power, Reyvateils. Her personality is very strange, by modern standards. She is very blatant and blunt. She likes food made from flour, such as breads and cakes. Her favorite and most desired food is agepan (fried bread).
From Ar Tonelico Wiki
A disestablishmentarian clergyman who leads a militia of people who don't belong to either Clustania or Archia.
He lives in Great Fang, and exerts great leadership and charisma by empowering the people with his eloquence and strength.
He's such a radical activist.
Tatsumi's V-Boarding technique was passed down from him.
From official site
The supreme commander of the Clustanian army.
The fact that she has risen to this position at her young age is worth everyone's notice.
She regards Finnel as an old friend, but because she was designed to have little human emotions, she's very subtle at expressing her feelings.
She has a familiar named Kukuro. Now that Finnel is gone, Kukuro's company is her only mental support.
From official site

cast.characterName: 光五条_ox.癒種ヴァーミリア・ヘプト
cast.originalCharacterName: 光五条_ox.癒種ヴァーミリア・ヘプト

segments.text: A Reyvatologist (a doctor who specializes on Reyvateils) who runs a clinic in Eternus Shaft.
He used to work as a medical doctor at the Archia Think Tank, but when he met a shocking revelation about the organization, he quit.
It seems like Richaryosha is involved with this issue, but...
From official site
One of Finnel's personas. A mysterious persona in a jester costume. Her actual identity is as Clustania's deadliest assassin.
In contrast to Finnel's clumsiness, she's very agile and has very sharp movement. She has the ability to make quick and accurate decisions.
However, her decisions are based on efficiency, so they sometimes turn out to be harmful to Finnel, especially, when she snaps.
From official site
She's a mysterious girl surrounded by enigmas.
She hardly ever manifests in the real world and even when she does, she is often oblivious to it at first.
What is her true identity...?
From official site

Suzunomia is in fact one of the Wills of Ar Ciel, and furthermore, her true name is Hymmnosphere, while her current name is a corrupted form of her traditional Goddess name, Suzunomiya. She is considered as one of the most important Wills due to her extremely high wave frequencies, and the fact that she is the Singing Will that keeps Ar Ciel filled with energy and alive, creating and supplying the Symphonic Power that both the Planet and the other Wills need to keep themselves alive.
She's very knowledgeable and intellectual.
She makes use of various technologies and supports Finnel in many aspects. She also asks Aoto to help protect Finnel.
The reason clumsy Finnel survived in Great Fang up until today may be because of her aid.
From official site
Singer: Akiko Shikata

Ar Ru is one of the greater wills of Ar Ciel. Her first priority is to preserve the life of the planet and she won't hesitate to re-format all life of Ar Ciel. In fact, she's very coy and shy. Along with her complicated personality, her preference in food is also very complex.
From Ar Tonelico Wiki
He fell in love with V-Boarding when Gengai from the Great Fang Militia and now he trains on his own, travelling to many places.
He has known Aoto for a month now. When he decided to help Aoto and Saki, his fate took a dramatic turn.
From official site
Age: 12 (15 in English release)
A girl who came from the distant world, Metafalss.
She is as young as she looks, but she's also a genius.
She runs a synthesis store called "Nyanya Shop" in the Kanpaihachi Hot Springs.
Edited from official site

The Chairman of the Archia Think Tank. He used to work as a researcher, but his project coordinating skills were highly recognized, and he was chosen to become the chairman. He virtually dictates over all affairs at the Think Tank; he supervises everything from household goods to military operations.

He is often criticized by the people of Great Fang and Clustania, but the Archians regard him highly, not only as the leader of their mammoth company, but as the defender of the city as well. They know humanity can safely survive in the Tower thanks to his efforts.
From official site
A close friend of Hikari and a researcher at the Moebius Factory.
He has made numerous achievements in the study of Reyvateils.
Katene is one of the few researchers Hikari trusts.
From official site
He works for the Great Fang Militia as Gengai's best spy.
Luphan willingly offers his help to Aoto and Saki.
From official site
A program that Hikari created in order to investigate Saki and Finnel's mutliple personae issues.
Teppo is an acronym for his real name, Trans Encoder & Personable Program Optimizer.
You see him by installing him as a plug-in. When Aoto Dives into them, Teppo keeps him company. Teppo is capable of detecting cracks in their minds and repairing them.
From official site
Singer: Au
A Third Generation Reyvateil. As a Clustanian platoon leader, she took on the mission of securing Saki.
Despite her manly looks, she is a very romantic girl.
From official site
Singer: Yayoi Yura
An AI located in the Third Tower in Sol Cluster.
Her personality can be changed and altered through different DLC: the free personality skins include Tsundere, Dorodere, Ultra Masochist and Pure White.
